about: The EQ of the effect rack of the Audio Unit (alone in the rack; osc A off, the noise oscillator plays an impulse of ours one-shot at 44.1 kHz after a quiet tone of 1 kHz that keeps the rack awake; a response is the FFT of 2^16 samples from the impulse through the EQ over the one of the dry render, the rack empty, dB, at `frequencies`). Its plain params: kParamType1/2 (0 a shelf: low of band 1, high of band 2; 1 a peak; 2 a pass: high of band 1, low of band 2; more is 2), kParamFreq1/2 (Hz), kParamReso1/2 (%), kParamGain1/2 (dB, none on a pass), kParamLevelOut (a knob). `fresh` [dB, degrees] of a fresh EQ; `defaults` [band, gain, dB] a fresh EQ with the gain of one band set; `level` [knob, dB]; `clamps` [band, type, Hz, reso, gain, dB] knobs out of their ranges and at their ends; `phase` [band, type, Hz, reso, gain, [dB, degrees]]; `q` [type, reso, dB at `qFrequencies`] band 1 at 1 kHz, gain 12 dB; `grid` [band, type, Hz, reso, gain, dB]; `rates` by rate the `rows` rendered at it, at its `frequencies` (the sample resampled alike with and without the EQ); scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=eq
